We left all the lights off because the first couple of hard rains in May and June every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. There’s no way to exterminate them as they are in almost every three in Puerto Rico and attracted by light. They are harmless but a pain to clean.They fly during the night of a very hard rain, it is VERY IMPORTANT that you leave all the LIGHTS OFF inside the apartment when you leave or while you are in there because these flying termites will come in. It's very hard to predict the date but I know it's around this time of the year.Please TURN OFF ALL the light when expected to come back at night or when leaving at night or if you are in the apartment and see flying bugs do so as well.
